1481.finding: Reference selects rows at the global minimum Consumption, then divides segment sums by a shared row count. Predictions select segment minima of annual customer aggregates. These are different minimum scopes and denominators.
1481.business_verdict: UNRESOLVED: least consumption and annual average need owner-defined grain

1482.finding: Reference returns three scalar segment changes and has no EUR predicate. Both predictions filter EUR and return segment-ranked rows. Output contract and population differ.
1482.business_verdict: REFERENCE_QUESTION_CONFLICT: question requests EUR and biggest/lowest segments; reference does not implement those literally

1526.finding: Question says paid 634.8. Predictions filter Amount=634.8; reference filters Price=1513.12 and joins gasstations. Money-versus-quantity and literal/population differences coexist.
1526.business_verdict: REFERENCE_QUESTION_CONFLICT: reference amount differs from the question; do not train a metric to reproduce it

1531.finding: Reference chooses CustomerID by highest single yearmonth Consumption and SUMs transaction unit prices. Predictions rank total transaction spending and AVG unit prices; retrieval also returns total spending.
1531.business_verdict: REFERENCE_QUESTION_CONFLICT: top spending and average differ from the reference selector and SUM

1533.finding: Reference preserves transaction-to-month join multiplicity and returns Consumption only. Predictions deduplicate qualifying customers or use EXISTS and return customer IDs; retrieval SUMs consumption by customer.
1533.business_verdict: UNRESOLVED: customer-versus-transaction multiplicity and output contract need adjudication

1472.finding: Both predictions retain the customer/annual SUM/filter/ranking logic but add total consumption to the result and a deterministic CustomerID tie-breaker. Reference returns CustomerID only.
1472.business_verdict: OUTPUT_SHAPE_OR_TIE_POLICY: extra columns alone can fail the stored comparator; IDs cannot be rechecked without the database

1473.finding: Reference computes AVG(Consumption)/12. Retrieval averages summed month totals; Model 1 averages customer-month totals. Population, denominator and aggregation grain differ.
1473.business_verdict: UNRESOLVED: average monthly consumption requires an explicit metric definition

1479.finding: Only Model 1 fails: it adds total consumption to the selected year. Retrieval returns the year alone, matching the reference shape.
1479.business_verdict: OUTPUT_SHAPE: no evidence that Model 1 chose the wrong year

1480.finding: Reference returns two-character month; predictions return YYYYMM plus total consumption. Model 1 uses EXISTS rather than the reference JOIN.
1480.business_verdict: OUTPUT_SHAPE_AND_FORMAT: date representation is different; do not infer a bad relationship from EXISTS

1490.finding: Reference percentage counts joined customer-month rows. Retrieval counts customers above a summed-consumption threshold, including zero-filled LEFT JOIN rows; Model 1 counts distinct customers with any qualifying month.
1490.business_verdict: UNRESOLVED: monthly rows, customer totals and any-month qualification are different metrics

1501.finding: Reference constrains yearmonth.Date after joining by CustomerID. Predictions constrain the actual transaction Date in June 2013. Missing yearmonth is observable, but selected-table counts do not prove retrieval omitted it.
1501.business_verdict: REFERENCE_QUESTION_CONFLICT: consumption-period membership is not the same as transaction event time

1529.finding: Reference joins transactions to every yearmonth for the customer, SUMs Price at that multiplied grain and gates January using yearmonth.Date. Predictions use transaction dates and avoid that fanout.
1529.business_verdict: REFERENCE_FANOUT_RISK: cannot label avoidance of multiplication a business error without adjudication

1498.finding: Only retrieval fails: it returns month plus monthly consumption, whereas reference and Model 1 return the maximum monthly total alone.
1498.business_verdict: OUTPUT_SHAPE: extra month column is sufficient to break exact result-shape comparison

1500.finding: Reference filters yearmonth.Date, joins by customer and retains descriptions with join multiplicity. Predictions filter transaction dates and use DISTINCT descriptions.
1500.business_verdict: REFERENCE_TIME_AND_GRAIN_RISK: event time and duplicate policy require adjudication

1525.finding: Retrieval counts distinct customers on the requested transaction day; reference counts transaction-weighted customer rows. Model 1 substitutes August yearmonth membership for the explicitly requested day.
1525.business_verdict: CONFIRMED_MODEL1_DAY_FILTER_LOSS; retrieval-versus-reference denominator still needs adjudication
